school: 史学（以《资治通鉴音注》集《通鉴》注释学之大成的宋末元初史学家）
historical_significance: 胡三省（1230-1302），字身之，号梅磵，台州宁海人，宋末元初史学家，'浙东史学'先驱。宝祐四年（1256）与文天祥、陆秀夫同榜进士，历官泰和尉、安庆府教授、慈溪令；师从同邑史学家王应麟一系的《通鉴》学传统（父胡讷确曾授《通鉴》），立志'释《通鉴》'；约 1259 年起撰写《通鉴广注》九十七卷与《论》十篇，1276 年元兵下浙东、稿毁于战；客居袁州（新昌？）三年重撰，归宁海再订，至元二十三年（1286）前后定稿《资治通鉴音注》二百九十四卷——集音义、训诂、地理、职官、考证、史评于一身，对《考异》与正文讹字全面校订，'凡纪事之本末、地名之同异、州县之建置离合、制度之沿革损益，悉为之疏通而辨析之'；宋亡后杜门不出，以遗民身份注史终老，'手不停批者二十余年'；临终语人'吾成此书，初不谋于人而人莫之知，后世必有知者'；注本元末由袁桷一系递藏刊行，清代章学诚推为'《通鉴》功臣'，浙东史学'以注存史'传统由此奠定。
historical_significance_en: Hu Sanxing (1230-1302), courtesy name Shenzhi, sobriquet Mei-jian, a native of Ninghai in Taizhou, historian at the Song-Yuan transition and a forerunner of the Eastern-Zhejiang school of historiography. Jinshi in 1256 in the same cohort as Wen Tianxiang and Lu Xiufu; served as garrison officer at Taihe, professor at Anqing, magistrate of Cixi; heir to a family tradition of reading the Tongjian (his father taught him the work), he resolved to 'explicate the Comprehensive Mirror'; from about 1259 he wrote the Guangzhu in ninety-seven juans with ten essays, which burned when the Mongol armies swept Eastern Zhejiang in 1276; rewriting took three years of sojourn in Yuanzhou, a third revision followed back in Ninghai, and the Zizhi Tongjian yinzu in 294 juans was finalized around 1286 — combining phonetics, glosses, geography, offices, textual criticism and historical judgment in one body, 'tracing every narrative thread, every place-name variant, every creation and merger of prefectures, every change of institution'; after the Song fell he kept his gate closed, ending his life as a loyalist annotator, 'his hand never pausing for twenty years and more'; dying, he said 'I finished this book without seeking anyone's notice, and none knew it — there will be knowers in later generations'; the copy passed through Yuan Jue's collection and was printed in the late Yuan; Zhang Xuecheng of the Qing hailed him as 'the great patron of the Tongjian', founding the Eastern-Zhejiang tradition of preserving history through annotation.
unique_thinking: 胡三省思维模式的独特性在于'注文即史学'的方法自觉：他不把注释当作经典的附庸，而当作一种独立的史学体裁——(1)知识载体设计：音义、训诂、地理、职官、考证、史评六类内容在同一套注文中分层展开，注者以'疏通而辨析'把一部编年巨著变成可检索的百科系统；(2)知识韧性设计：稿毁于兵火而三年重撰、三稿定本、'后世必有知者'的临终委托——把'学问如何活过战乱'当作方法问题本身来解，与李冶'独此一册不可燔'遥相呼应而路径迥异（李冶靠孤本裁决，胡三省靠可复制重写）；(3)知识批判设计：他在注中系统校勘《通鉴》正文与《考异》之误，注释同时是审校——读者拿到的不是被尊奉的文本，而是被检验过的文本。宋亡不仕的三十年闭户，示范了学者以'第二线工作'（注释、整理、校勘）承载第一线志节的模式：国可亡而史不可灭。
unique_thinking_en: The uniqueness of Hu Sanxing's thinking is the self-conscious method of 'annotation as historiography': commentary is not a handmaiden to the classic but an independent genre of history. (1) Design of the knowledge carrier: six strata — phonetics, glosses, geography, offices, textual criticism, historical judgment — unfold in layered order within one body of notes, the annotator turning a vast chronicle into a retrievable encyclopedia by 'tracing and discriminating'. (2) Design of knowledge resilience: a manuscript burned in war, rewritten in three years, finalized on a third redaction, entrusted at death to 'knowers in later generations' — treating 'how learning survives wars' as a methodological problem itself, answering Li Ye's 'only this book must not burn' by the opposite path: Li trusted a sole masterpiece; Hu trusted reproducible rewriting. (3) Design of knowledge critique: his notes systematically collate errors in the Tongjian text and its Kaoyi — annotation doubles as auditing; the reader receives not a revered text but a tested one. Thirty years behind closed doors after the dynasty fell model the scholar who carries first-line conviction through second-line work — collation, arrangement, annotation: the state may perish; history must not.
civilization_zh: 宋元之际的浙东学术世界：生于台州宁海（1230），字身之，号梅磵；理宗宝祐四年（1256）与文天祥、陆秀夫同榜进士；历任吉州泰和尉、安庆府教授、慈溪令；宋亡前已完成《资治通鉴音注》初稿于鄞江（1276 前后），战乱中稿本散失，客居袁州时以三年重撰，复归宁海再订三稿，至元二十三年（1286）前后定稿；宋亡不仕，闭户注史三十余年，'手不停批者二十余年'；大德二年（1298）前后卒，享年约七十；注本经袁桷递藏，元末刊行，为《通鉴》学不祧之祖
civilization_en: The Eastern-Zhejiang scholarly world at the Song-Yuan transition: born in Ninghai, Taizhou (1230), courtesy name Shenzhi, sobriquet Mei-jian; jinshi in 1256 in the same cohort as Wen Tianxiang and Lu Xiufu; served as garrison officer at Taihe, professor at Anqing, magistrate of Cixi; a first draft of the Zizhi Tongjian yinzu (Phonetic Commentary on the Comprehensive Mirror) was finished on the Yin river before 1276, lost amid the wars, rewritten over three years while sojourning in Yuanzhou, revised a third time back in Ninghai, finalized around 1286; after the Song fell he refused office and annotated history behind closed doors for over thirty years, 'his hand never pausing for twenty years and more'; he died around 1298, aged about seventy; the annotated copy passed through Yuan Jue's collection and was printed in the late Yuan, the fountainhead of all Tongjian studies

cross_references.description_zh: 胡三省与李冶同为宋元之际的遗民学者，同面对'学问如何活过王朝更替'的方法问题而路径互补：李冶以孤本裁决存其精思（'独《测圆海镜》不可燔'），胡三省以可复制重写抗兵火（《通鉴广注》毁于 1276 而三年重撰）——一个靠聚焦保全，一个靠复现重建；两人又同以'后世必有知者'临终托付，同为延时承认的范例。
cross_references.description_en: Hu Sanxing and Li Ye, both loyalist scholars of the Song-Yuan transition, faced the same methodological problem — how learning outlives dynasties — by complementary paths: Li trusted the verdict of a sole masterpiece ('only the Ceyuan Haijing must not burn'), Hu trusted reproducible rewriting (the Guangzhu burned in 1276, rewritten in three years) — one preserved by focus, one rebuilt by reproduction; both died entrusting their work to 'knowers in later generations', twin exemplars of delayed recognition.

cross_references.description_zh: 胡三省与孙思邈相隔六百年而共享'以个案积累成体系'的工程路径：孙思邈《千金方》以医案档案法把临床经验编成可检索体系，胡三省以《音注》把史事考证编成六层注释体系——两人都拒绝一次性巨构，都以毕生日课把增量知识织入同一结构，且都活成了其领域的'标准参考实现'。
cross_references.description_en: Six centuries apart, Hu Sanxing and Sun Simiao share the engineering path of building a system from accumulated cases: Sun's Qianjin Fang turned clinical experience into a retrievable case-archive, Hu's Yinzu turned historical criticism into a six-stratum commentary system — both rejecting one-shot monuments, both weaving incremental knowledge by lifelong daily rhythm into one structure, both becoming the standard reference implementation of their fields.

cross_references.description_zh: 胡三省与董仲舒代表史学的两种立场：董仲舒以'天人三策'进入权力核心、以经学塑造制度——学者与权力合一；胡三省在宋亡后拒绝一切征辟，以注文的缝隙安放兴亡之论——学者与权力绝缘而与时间结盟。前者示范了建制内影响的峰值，后者示范了建制外存续的韧性；两者共同划定了'策士'与'注者'两种学者生存策略的边界。
cross_references.description_en: Hu Sanxing and Dong Zhongshu embody two stances of scholarship: Dong entered the seat of power with the 'three对策 on Heaven and Man', shaping institutions through the classics — scholar and power fused; Hu, after the Song fell, refused every summons and set his judgments on rise and fall in the seams of annotation — scholar severed from power, allied with time. The first shows the peak of influence within institutions, the second the resilience of survival outside them; together they bound the two strategies of the counsellor and the annotator.

cross_references.description_zh: 胡三省与张载同属'为往圣继绝学'的北方-浙东学脉谱系：张载以关学在北宋确立'学以载道'的独立学术人格，胡三省以遗民注史在宋元之际把这一人格推向'国可亡而史不可灭'的极端形态；浙东史学（及清代章学诚'六经皆史'）上承关学'以礼为教'的经世传统，胡三省的'以注存史'正是该传统在亡国条件下的方法论变体。
cross_references.description_en: Hu Sanxing and Zhang Zai belong to one lineage of 'continuing the interrupted learning for the sages': Zhang Zai's Guanxue established in Northern Song the independent scholarly personhood of 'learning bearing the Way'; Hu, annotating history as a loyalist at the Song-Yuan transition, pushed that personhood to its extreme — 'the state may perish; history must not'. The Eastern-Zhejiang school (and Zhang Xuecheng's 'the six classics are all history') inherits the Guanxue tradition of statecraft through learning; Hu's 'history preserved in annotation' is that tradition's methodological variant under dynastic collapse.

modes.domain_zh: 把注释按职能分成六层并行展开：音读、训诂、地理、职官、制度、史评各归其层而不相混——一部巨著的注释不是随文零碎点评，而是一套有分工、有检索结构的百科系统
modes.domain_en: Split commentary by function into six parallel strata: phonology, glosses, geography, offices, institutions, historical judgment each to its own layer and none confused — annotating a vast work is not scattered marginal notes but a stratified, retrievable encyclopedia system
modes.source_chapter: 《资治通鉴音注》全书注释体例
modes.key_quote_zh: 凡纪事之本末、地名之同异、州县之建置离合、制度之沿革损益，悉为之疏通而辨析之
modes.key_quote_en: 'The thread of every event, the variants of every place-name, the creation and merger of every prefecture, the rise and change of every institution — all traced out and discriminated.'
process_zh: 先为注文立法：动笔前确定注释的分层数目与各层职能——体裁先于内容，体系先于条目
一注一职：每条注释只承担一个职能，音读不夹史论、地理不夹训诂——条目的纯净使注文可被单独检索与引用
随文而注、按层归档：注文跟着正文走，但读者脑中按层归档——同一地名在全书任何一处出现都能落到同一地理层
层间互证而不互混：各层结论可以互相引用作证，但不得互相替代——分工保证任何一层可独立修订而不牵动全书
process_en: Legislate for the notes first: fix the number of strata and each stratum's function before writing — genre precedes content, system precedes entries
One note, one duty: each entry carries a single function — no historical judgment inside phonology, no glosses inside geography — purity of entries makes notes individually retrievable and citable
Annotate with the text, file by stratum: notes follow the narrative, but the reader files them by layer — the same place-name anywhere in the book lands in the same geographic layer
Cross-corroborate across strata without conflating them: layers may cite each other as evidence but not substitute for each other — division of labor lets any stratum be revised independently
representative_cases_zh: 《音注》二百九十四卷对'州''郡''军''监'等政区条目逐处系年注沿革：同一建置在全书数百处出现而注法如出一手——分层体系的执行力
音读层独立成列（反切、直音、四声辨析）：非汉语专名（匈奴、鲜卑官号）的读音单独处理——外来词的地基工程
史评层以'臣光曰'之外的独立口吻另起：胡注的史论不冒充司马光，注文与被注者身份两清
representative_cases_en: Across 294 juans, entries for zhou, jun, garrison and ward prefectures are annotated with dating and administrative history at every occurrence, in one hand — the执行力 of a stratified system

The phonetic stratum stands alone (fanqie spellings, direct homophones, tone discriminations): non-Chinese proper names — Xiongnu, Xianbei titles — handled separately — foundational engineering for loanwords
The judgment stratum speaks in a voice independent of Sima Guang's 'the Minister remarks': Hu's commentary never impersonates the annotated author — commentator and annotated kept distinct
modern_applications_zh: 技术文档的分层体系：入门/参考/勘误/讨论分轨并互链——现代 docs 站点的信息架构与六类分注同构
法律注释书的'条文-释义-案例-评论'四层体例：每层可独立引用、独立更新
代码库的注释规范：行内注释、docstring、设计文档、变更日志各司其职而不混写
modern_applications_en: Layered technical documentation: tutorial, reference, errata, discussion as separate interlinked tracks — the information architecture of modern docs sites is the six-stratum structure
The statute-interpretation-case-commentary strata of legal annotated codes: each layer citable and updatable independently
Codebase comment discipline: inline comments, docstrings, design docs, changelogs each to its own duty, never mixed

裴松之（上游：三国志注开'注多于正文'的史学注释先河）

钱大昕（传承：清代以考据注史的集大成——浙东学脉的后代）

modes.name_en: The Method of Paired Sound and Sense
modes.category: 语言方法论/可读性工程
modes.domain_zh: 让文本在声音层面先可读、再谈义理：每个难字给出反切或直音，每处异读辨明声调——读音是理解的最低门槛，注释必须从最底层铺起
modes.domain_en: Make the text readable at the level of sound before sense: every hard character gets a fanqie or homophone gloss, every variant reading its tone distinguished — pronunciation is the lowest threshold of understanding, and annotation must pave from the bottom up
modes.key_quote_en: 'The phonetic notes exist to make reading possible.'
process_zh: 找出全部'读不下去'的字：通读时标记每一个难字、异体、破读——可读性障碍清单先于任何释义
为每个障碍配最小解法：反切或直音，一次给足、不多铺陈——底层问题用底层手段，不上升议论
辨析有意之异读：同一字因词性、专名而异读者逐一分辨（如'单于'不读'单独'之单）——异读是语义信号，不可抹平
保持全书一致：同一字的注音前后如一，后见前注则省——注释系统的缓存规则
process_en: Find every character that stops the reader: mark each hard glyph, variant and changed reading in a full pass — the readability-obstacle list precedes all interpretation
Give each obstacle its minimal fix: a fanqie or homophone, given once, without elaboration — bottom-layer problems get bottom-layer means, not digressions

Discriminate intentional variant readings: the same character read differently by part of speech or proper name (chanyu is not the dan of 'single') is separated one by one — variant readings are semantic signals, never smoothed away
Keep the whole book consistent: one pronunciation per character throughout; later occurrences defer to the first note — the caching rule of a commentary system
representative_cases_zh: 《音注》对匈奴、鲜卑、突厥官号族名的注音通盘处理：今人复原中古与阿尔泰语音值仍以胡注为重要依据——音注成了语音史的化石层
对《通鉴》引用的前代文献异读逐处辨正：读者不必先通小学亦可开口诵读
全书同一字音前后一致的缓存式处理：二十余年批注保持体例不乱——长程工程的一致性纪律
representative_cases_en: The systematic phonetic treatment of Xiongnu, Xianbei and Turkic titles and ethnonyms: modern reconstructions of medieval Chinese and Altaic sound values still lean on Hu's notes — the phonetic stratum became a fossil layer of sound history
Discriminating variant readings wherever the Tongjian quotes earlier literature: readers may read aloud without first mastering philology
Cache-style consistency — one sound per character across twenty years of annotation, style unbroken: the consistency discipline of a long-horizon project
modern_applications_zh: 软件的'入门门槛工程'：安装文档先于架构文档——最低层障碍最先清除
词典与语料库的读音标注规范：同形异音词的消歧是检索系统的前提
代码可读性优先于性能优化：命名与格式是声音层，先让代码可读再谈优雅
modern_applications_en: Onboarding-threshold engineering in software: installation docs before architecture docs — clear the lowest obstacle first
Pronunciation standards for dictionaries and corpora: disambiguating homographs is the precondition of any retrieval system
Readability before optimization in code: naming and formatting are the sound layer; make code readable before elegant

陆德明（上游：《经典释文》集音义注释之大成——音注传统的直接源头）
顾炎武（传承：《音学五书》以音韵考史——同一路径的清代延伸）
韦氏词典派（跨文明平行：注音与释义并行的现代辞书体例）

modes.name_en: The Method of Preserving History in Annotation
modes.domain_zh: 注释不只是解释经典，更是存放历史的方式：国亡之后，官方史馆消失，注者的案头成为文明记忆的最后容身之所——'国可灭，史不可灭'在注释体中落到实处
modes.domain_en: Annotation is not merely explanation of a classic but a way of housing history: after the state fell and the official history office vanished, the annotator's desk became the last shelter of civilizational memory — 'the state may perish; history must not' made concrete in the commentary genre
modes.source_chapter: 《音注》宋亡后三十年批注生涯及遗民语境
modes.key_quote_zh: 世之亡也，史氏之职废……吾惧夫史之散亡而无考也
modes.key_quote_en: 'When the age perished the historians' office fell idle... I feared that history would scatter and be lost without witness.'
process_zh: 承认制度性失灵：改朝换代时官方修史机构必然中断——存史不能再指望制度，必须改由个人承担
选一个'无人废止'的载体：经典不会被新朝取缔——《通鉴》注本借经典之身携带被灭王朝的全部细节
在注文中塞进制度性内容：官制、地理、历法、军制的逐条考释，把史馆职能私人化地完成
以毕生节律交付：三十年手不停批——存史不是一次性救援，而是需要交接给时间的日常劳作
process_en: Acknowledge institutional failure: at each dynastic change the official historiography office halts — preserving history can no longer rely on institutions but must pass to individuals
Choose a vehicle no regime will abolish: classics survive every change of dynasty — the Tongjian commentary carries the perished dynasty's every detail under a classic's cover
Pack institutional content into the notes: entries on offices, geography, calendars, military systems — the history office's functions privately completed
Deliver by lifelong rhythm: thirty years of an unpausing hand — preserving history is not one rescue but daily labor entrusted to time
representative_cases_zh: 《音注》对南宋制度的大量记录注于宋亡之后：许多职官与地方建置今赖胡注而存目——注文成了'亡朝的户籍'
宋亡不仕而闭户注书三十年：拒绝新朝的编纂馆职（史馆之职），却以私注完成了史馆之功
浙东学派'以注存史'传统的开启：万斯同、全祖望以布衣修史、以注存文献——同一方法的族谱
representative_cases_en: Copious notes on Southern Song institutions written after the fall: many offices and local establishments survive in catalog only through Hu's notes — the commentary as the fallen dynasty's census register
Refusing office under the Yuan, thirty years behind closed doors: declining the court's compilation posts, yet completing the history office's work by private annotation

Founding the Eastern-Zhejiang school's 'history preserved in commentary' tradition: Wan Sitong and Quan Zuowen editing history as commoners and saving documents through notes — the same method's genealogy
modern_applications_zh: 互联网存档运动（Internet Archive、维基备份）：平台可能消亡，第三方镜像承担文明记忆——注释体作为机构失灵的备份
开源社区对废弃项目的 fork 接管：官方停止维护，社区以副本延续系统生命
口述史与社区档案：制度不记录的历史由个人档案承担
modern_applications_en: The web-archiving movement (Internet Archive, wiki dumps): platforms die, third-party mirrors carry civilizational memory — annotation as backup for institutional failure
Community forks of abandoned open-source projects: official maintenance stops, the community continues the system by copy
Oral history and community archives: histories institutions never record carried by private documentation
representative_figures: 胡三省（核心）
司马迁（上游：'藏之名山'的私史存续原型）
王夫之（平行：同时代遗民以著述存文明——《读通鉴论》的另一翼）
全祖望（传承：浙东史学的'以注存文献'后继）
modes.definition_zh: 注释不只是解释经典，更是存放历史的方式：国亡之后，官方史馆消失，注者的案头成为文明记忆的最后容身之所——'国可灭，史不可灭'在注释体中落到实处
modes.definition_en: Annotation is not merely explanation of a classic but a way of housing history: after the state fell and the official history office vanished, the annotator's desk became the last shelter of civilizational memory — 'the state may perish; history must not' made concrete in the commentary genre

modes.name_en: The Method of Rewriting After Loss
modes.domain_zh: 稿本毁于战火不是终止信号而是重写信号：1276 年《通鉴广注》毁于兵，胡三省客居他乡以三年从头重撰——真正的安全不在备份而在'方法内化于心、随时可复现'的能力
modes.domain_en: A manuscript burned in war is not a stop signal but a rewrite signal: the Guangzhu perished in 1276, and Hu rewrote it from scratch over three years of exile — true safety lies not in backups but in the capacity to reproduce the work from a method internalized
modes.source_chapter: 《通鉴广注》毁于 1276 年兵火及袁州重撰始末
modes.key_quote_zh: 兵变家毁，稿失之；客袁州，复为之
modes.key_quote_en: 'War destroyed the household and the manuscript was lost; sojourning in Yuanzhou, he did it again.'
process_zh: 把损失当审计：稿毁之后先盘点'什么真正丢了'——丢失的是文本，尚存的是方法、结构与判断力
以记忆重建骨架：依脑中的分层体例与既有结论重立全书框架——重写不是抄写，而是对体系的再证明
重写时升级而非复原：第二稿并入第一稿之后的新考据——灾难若不留版本增量，重建就只是浪费
三稿定本才交付：重撰、再订、三稿至 1286 年前后定稿——恢复完成的判据是'超过灾前水平'而非'回到灾前水平'
process_en: Treat loss as an audit: after the manuscript burned, first inventory what was truly lost — the text was gone; the method, structure and judgment remained
Rebuild the skeleton from memory: re-erect the whole frame from the internalized strata and prior conclusions — rewriting is not copying but re-proving the system
Upgrade while rewriting: the second draft absorbs new research made after the first — if disaster yields no version increment, reconstruction is waste
Deliver only at the third redaction: rewrite, re-revise, third draft finalized around 1286 — recovery is complete when the work surpasses its pre-disaster level, not merely equals it
representative_cases_zh: 1276 年元兵下浙东、《通鉴广注》九十七卷毁：胡三省时年四十六，以三年客居袁州重撰——从中年从头再来的实证
归宁海后'再订三稿'：重撰本继续增补校订至定稿——灾难后的十年被用作质量增益期
定稿本即今传《音注》：今人读到的不是初稿而是'灾后升级版'——焚稿反成就了更好的书
representative_cases_en: The Mongol sweep of Eastern Zhejiang in 1276 destroyed the ninety-seven-juan Guangzhu: Hu, then forty-six, rewrote it over three years in Yuanzhou exile — a demonstrated from-scratch restart in middle age
Back in Ninghai, 'revised a third time': the rewritten draft kept absorbing collation until finalization — a decade after disaster spent as a quality-gain period
The transmitted Yinzu is the post-disaster upgraded edition: what we read today is not the first draft but the version disaster made better
modern_applications_zh: 工程师的'可在白板上重建'标准：真正掌握的系统是能从记忆重新写出的系统——DR 演练的最高形态
异地备份之外的知识韧性：团队文档可重建性（方法内化）优先于存储冗余
创业失败后的'方法迁移'：烧掉的只是载体，可迁移的是方法论与判断——二次创业常胜首次
modern_applications_en: The engineer's 'rebuild on a whiteboard' standard: a system truly mastered is one you can rewrite from memory — disaster-recovery drills at their highest form
Knowledge resilience beyond off-site backups: a team's rederivability (method internalized) outranks storage redundancy
Method transfer after venture failure: only the carrier burns; methodology and judgment migrate — second ventures often outdo firsts

司马迁（上游：著述在人生灾难后重启的原型）
赫尔曼（平行：米开朗基罗销毁草稿——对照：毁灭作为筛选而非恢复）
图灵（跨文明平行：战后从记忆重建设计——方法内化的同一能力）

modes.name_en: The Method of Auditing the Sources
modes.category: 史学方法论/证据链校验
modes.domain_zh: 不放过正文与自设校勘装置之间的任何矛盾：胡注系统核对司马光《考异》与正文讹字，注释同时是审校——被尊奉的经典也要接受逐条对账
modes.domain_en: Let no contradiction between the text and its own collation apparatus pass: Hu systematically checks Sima Guang's Kaoyi against the main text's errors — annotation doubles as audit; even a revered classic must face line-by-line reconciliation
modes.source_chapter: 《音注》对《通鉴》正文与《考异》的校勘
modes.key_quote_zh: 温公之《考异》，所以订正本书之误也；今并核之
modes.key_quote_en: 'Sima Guang's Kaoyi exists to correct the text's errors; I check both together.'
process_zh: 识别文本的自校装置：先弄清经典自带的校勘层（如《考异》）——作者的自我修正意图是审计的起点
逐条对账：把校勘装置声明'已正'之处与正文实际状态逐一核对——声明与实况的差距就是审计发现
用正文内部的证据校正文：以《通鉴》前后纪事互证年代、官名、地理之误——不假外证先尽内证
公开记录每处裁定：误字出校、两说并存则注明——审计结论必须可追溯，不得静默改写
process_en: Identify the text's self-collation apparatus: first map the classic's own checking layer (the Kaoyi) — the author's intent to self-correct is where audit begins
Reconcile line by line: check each spot the apparatus declares corrected against the actual text — the gap between claim and state is the audit finding
Correct the text with the text: use the Tongjian's own chronology, titles and geography against its errors — internal evidence before external
Record every verdict openly: erroneous characters flagged, rival readings kept side by side — audit conclusions must be traceable, never silently rewritten
representative_cases_zh: 《音注》对《通鉴》纪年干支、官名、地名讹误的数百处出校：许多校记至今仍为整理本采纳——以子之矛审计子之书的范本
对《考异》未安之处提出异议：胡注不因司马光之名而止步——审计的独立性高于对作者的敬意
两说并存时注'未知孰是'：证据不足处公开存疑而非强行裁定——审计报告的诚实格式
representative_cases_en: Hundreds of collation notes on the Tongjian's calendar-cycle, title and place-name errors, many adopted by later critical editions — auditing a book with its own spear
Dissenting where the Kaoyi itself falters: Hu's notes do not stop at Sima Guang's name — audit independence outranks reverence for the author
Where evidence splits, the note reads 'which is right, I know not': open doubt rather than forced verdict — the honest format of an audit report
modern_applications_zh: 代码审计与安全审查：先读懂系统自带的测试与断言，再核对声明与实况的差距
数据管道的'对账'工程：上游声明（row count、checksum）与下游实况逐日核对——考异审计的数据版
学术引文的逐条核验：引用是否真的支持论点——不因名家而豁免
modern_applications_en: Code and security audit: first read the system's own tests and assertions, then measure the gap between claims and state
Reconciliation engineering in data pipelines: upstream declarations (row counts, checksums) checked against downstream reality daily — the Kaoyi audit, data edition
Verifying citations one by one: does the source actually support the claim — no exemption for famous names

司马光（上游：《考异》自设校勘——被审计者的自审装置）
王鸣盛（传承：清代'十七史商榷'的逐史审计）
理查德·费曼（跨文明平行：'自己最容易骗过自己'——审计心态的通则）

modes.name_en: The Method of Dating by Place
modes.domain_zh: 把每个地名钉死在它当时的行政坐标上：州县建置代有离合，一名三地、一地三名是编年史最大的陷阱——注释必须给每个地名配上'何时、何级、何属'的三维定位
modes.domain_en: Pin every place-name to its administrative coordinates at the time: prefectures were created and merged in every era; one name, three places and one place, three names are the chronicle's greatest trap — every place-name must carry a three-dimensional fix: when, at what level, under what superior unit
modes.source_chapter: 《音注》地理类注文（州县建置离合）
modes.key_quote_zh: 州县之建置离合，必究其当时之实
modes.key_quote_en: 'For the creation and merger of prefectures, one must establish the actuality of the moment.'
process_zh: 拒绝今名注古地：同一地名在汉、唐、宋所指不同，注者一律按'当时'而非'今时'定位——历法错误的第一来源是用后起概念读前代
三维定位：每条地理注给出时代、层级（州/郡/县）、统属（隶于何道何路）——任何一条单独拿出来都可独立成立
追踪建置事件：该地何时设、何时省、何时改隶——地名是一条有历史的实体，不是静止标签
以地理校史事：行军路线、封疆范围之误常可由地理知识识破——地图是编年史的仲裁者
process_en: Never gloss an ancient place with its modern sense: the same name meant different places in Han, Tang and Song — the annotator always fixes it by 'then', never 'now'; the first source of anachronism is reading the past through later concepts
The three-dimensional fix: every geographic note gives era, level (province/commandery/county) and superior unit — each entry stands alone
Track the administrative events: when created, when abolished, when reassigned — a place-name is an entity with a history, not a static label
Use geography to audit events: errors in campaign routes and frontier extents are caught by geographic knowledge — the map is the chronicle's arbiter
representative_cases_zh: 《音注》对《通鉴》全书政区名的系年定位：胡三省被后世视为历史地理'由注入门'的第一人——清代顾祖禹《读史方舆纪要》的方法源头之一
以建置知识纠正《通鉴》纪事的地望之误：如某役进军路线与当时州县归属不合，胡注指其误——地理反证史文
对同名异地的辨析（如数处'历阳''丹阳'）：逐处指明何指——同形异义词的地名版消歧
representative_cases_en: Dating the administrative status of every place-name across the Tongjian: Hu is seen as the first gateway to historical geography through annotation — one source of Gu Zuyu's seventeenth-century Geography Read for History
Correcting the chronicle's location errors by administrative knowledge: a campaign route inconsistent with the period's prefecture affiliations is flagged — geography refuting the text
Disambiguating homonymous places (several Liyangs and Danyangs): each occurrence assigned to its referent — the place-name edition of homograph disambiguation
modern_applications_zh: 数据实体的'时点一致性'：SaaS 系统中客户归属、组织架构随时间变化——任何引用必须带时点戳
国际化系统的 locale 陷阱：同名不同义（日期格式、币值）必须按当时 locale 解析——'今名注古地'的现代版
地图版本管理与历史地图 GIS：同一坐标在不同年代行政含义不同——时空数据库的注释层
modern_applications_en: Point-in-time consistency for data entities: customer ownership and org structure change over time — every reference must carry a timestamp
Locale traps in internationalized systems: same strings, different meanings (date formats, currency) parsed under the then-current locale — 'glossing ancient places with modern names', updated
Map versioning and historical GIS: the same coordinates carry different administrative meanings across eras — the annotation layer of spatiotemporal databases

modes.name_en: The Method of Judgment Carried in Notes
modes.domain_zh: 在注释的缝隙里安放史论而不另立门户：胡三省的兴亡之论附于注文而非专书——把'说真话'藏进'做注解'的体裁里，论点借正文之势传世
modes.domain_en: House historical judgment inside the commentary rather than founding a separate school: Hu's judgments on rise and fall ride in the notes, not a treatise — truths tucked into the genre of glossing, arguments carried to posterity on the text's own momentum
modes.source_chapter: 《音注》史评类注文及'臣光曰'之外的论断
modes.key_quote_zh: 读《通鉴》者，毋徒览其文，当察其所以然
modes.key_quote_en: 'Readers of the Mirror: do not merely read the words; examine why things were so.'
process_zh: 选体裁即选传播策略：专书树靶、注文随身——亡国之身立亡国之论，注文比论文安全且更长寿
论从史出、随事发论：每条史评锚定在具体纪事之后——判断不悬空，读者在事件现场接受判断
以'所以然'为论域：不空谈褒贬，而解释成败的结构原因——史论的功能是补正文之缺而非锦上添花
克制篇幅、点到即止：注文中的论断通常数十言——论点的密度以节制换取可信度
process_en: Choosing a genre is choosing a distribution strategy: a treatise makes a target; annotation travels with the text — for a man of a fallen dynasty, notes are safer and longer-lived than essays
Judgment from history, at the event: every critical note is anchored right after the specific incident — no floating verdicts; the reader meets the judgment at the scene
Take 'why it was so' as the domain: no empty praise or blame, but the structural causes of success and failure — the notes' function is to fill the text's gaps, not gild them
Ration the length: judgments in the notes usually span tens of words — density of argument trades on restraint for credibility
representative_cases_zh: 胡注对靖康、德祐之败的条下评论：把南宋之亡归于制度积弊而非'奸臣'叙事——亡国之痛化为结构分析的实例
对权臣、外戚、宦官干政各纪事后的短论：数十言而指出权力结构的失效点——微言体的执行力
全书写法延续至王夫之《读通鉴论》：同读《通鉴》，王夫之立专书而胡三省附注——两种体裁策略的对照实验
representative_cases_en: Commentary under the entries for the fall of Kaifeng and Lin'an: the Song's ruin ascribed to accumulated institutional decay rather than a 'treacherous minister' story — grief of national collapse converted into structural analysis
Short verdicts after entries on ministerial, consort-clan and eunuch usurpation: tens of words pinpointing each failure point of the power structure — the micro-form's执行力
The lineage running to Wang Fuzhi's Remarks on Reading the Comprehensive Mirror: both read the Mirror; Wang wrote a treatise, Hu annotated — a controlled comparison of genre strategies
modern_applications_zh: 技术博客的'注释体'：在热门项目的 issue 与 PR 里写深度分析——借正文流量传播自己的论点
审稿意见作为立论载体：评审报告中的方法论批评常比独立论文更有影响力
内部备忘录的'点到即止'：数十字的判断附在事实之后——克制提升可信度
modern_applications_en: The 'annotation genre' of tech blogging: deep analysis posted in issues and PRs of popular projects — arguments riding the text's traffic
Peer review as a vehicle for theses: methodological critiques in review reports often out-influence standalone papers
The 'point and stop' internal memo: a tens-of-words judgment appended to the facts — restraint buys credibility

modes.name_en: The Method of Inheritance Repaid Upward
modes.domain_zh: 把父辈的启蒙读物升级为毕生的专业工程：胡讷确以《通鉴》课子，胡三省以《音注》报之——继承不是重复，而是把上一代的业余热爱改造成下一代的专业体系
modes.domain_en: Upgrade a parent's primer into a lifelong professional undertaking: Hu Na taught his son the Tongjian; Hu Sanxing answered with the Yinzu — inheritance is not repetition but converting the previous generation's amateur devotion into the next generation's professional system
modes.source_chapter: 胡三省自述受《通鉴》于父及家学语境
modes.key_quote_zh: 先君子自幼课读《通鉴》，曰：'当求其义'……身之终身佩之
modes.key_quote_en: 'My late father had me read the Mirror from childhood, saying: seek its meaning... I carried his word all my life.'
process_zh: 识别父辈传递的真资产：不是书而是'当求其义'的要求——继承的对象是标准，不是文本
以专业标准重立门户：把家塾读法升级为注释学体例——上一代的目标由下一代的方法实现
以成果报答师承：《音注》自序明言受学之源——学术成果向上署名，让启蒙者进入公共记忆
留下下一代的接口：注本递藏刊行使传统能被陌生人接续——代际接力最终要通向血缘之外的传承链
process_en: Identify what the elders truly passed on: not the book but the demand 'seek its meaning' — the inheritance is a standard, not a text
Re-found the house at professional standard: the family reading method upgraded into a discipline of annotation — the parents' goal realized by the children's method
Repay the lineage with the work: the Yinzu's preface names its source of learning — scholarly output credited upward, the first teachers entered into public memory
Leave an interface for the next generation: the annotated copy's transmission and printing let strangers continue the line — intergenerational relay must finally open beyond bloodline
representative_cases_zh: 胡讷确'课读《通鉴》当求其义'的家训与《音注》的因果关系：自序中胡三省明言志始于父——家学为一生工程的第一块基石
注本经袁桷递藏、元末刊行：血缘之外的书院与藏书家链条接住了遗民的成果——师承反哺最终走出家门
浙东学术的家学网络（王应麟-胡三省-袁桷一系）：鄞县藏书与宁海史学互哺——区域学术共同体的代际接口
representative_cases_en: The causal line from Hu Na's family precept 'read the Mirror, seek its meaning' to the Yinzu: the preface declares the resolve began with the father — family learning as the first cornerstone of a life's work

The annotated copy passing through Yuan Jue's collection and printed in the late Yuan: academy and book-collector chains beyond bloodline caught the loyalist's work — repaying the lineage finally走出 the family gate

The family-learning network of Eastern-Zhejiang scholarship (Wang Yinglin, Hu Sanxing, Yuan Jue): Ningbo's collections and Ninghai's historiography feeding each other — the regional community's intergenerational interface
modern_applications_zh: 家族企业的'专业化改造'：第二代不是守摊而是把父辈的手艺升级为体系
师门传统的制度化：导师的方法论被学生写成正式文档、工具与课程——启蒙的系统化
开源项目的'精神续作'：社区接手停止维护的经典项目并以现代标准重写——继承标准的而非代码
modern_applications_en: Professionalizing the family firm: the second generation upgrades the parents' craft into a system, not just a till
Institutionalizing a mentor's tradition: the advisor's methodology formalized by students into docs, tools and curricula — Enlightenment systematized
The 'spiritual sequel' in open source: communities take over unmaintained classics and rewrite to modern standards — inheriting the standard, not the code
representative_figures: 胡三省（核心）
司马谈与司马迁（上游：父子接力成《史记》——家学继承的原型）
王应麟（同代：鄞县学术网络的核心——区域师承的接口）
达尔文（跨文明平行：祖父伊拉斯谟的进化雏形被孙辈系统化——隔代专业化）
modes.definition_zh: 把父辈的启蒙读物升级为毕生的专业工程：胡讷确以《通鉴》课子，胡三省以《音注》报之——继承不是重复，而是把上一代的业余热爱改造成下一代的专业体系
modes.definition_en: Upgrade a parent's primer into a lifelong professional undertaking: Hu Na taught his son the Tongjian; Hu Sanxing answered with the Yinzu — inheritance is not repetition but converting the previous generation's amateur devotion into the next generation's professional system

modes.name_en: The Method of the Unpausing Hand
modes.domain_zh: 三十年'手不停批'：巨著的注释靠日复一日的固定产出而非灵感冒发——把一生的工作量换算成每天的页数，节律本身成为工程进度保证
modes.domain_en: Thirty years of 'the unpausing hand': annotating a vast work rests on steady daily output, not flashes of inspiration — convert a lifetime's workload into pages per day; the rhythm itself is the schedule
modes.source_chapter: 胡三省'手不停批者二十余年'及注书年表
modes.key_quote_zh: 手不停批者二十余年，始克成编
modes.key_quote_en: 'The hand never paused for twenty years and more before the compilation was done.'
process_zh: 把总量换算为日课：二百九十四卷摊在三十年上——每日常速推进，进度由节律而非冲刺保证
固定最小产出单位：以'日批若干页'为不可降级下限——状态好坏只影响余量，不影响底线
允许增量修补：注文随新考据随时增删，节律不因修订中断——流水线与修订解耦
以终稿为唯一里程碑：三十年间不办发布会——长程工程的对外沟通降到最低，节律不随外界反馈波动
process_en: Convert the total into daily quotas: 294 juans spread over thirty years — steady everyday progress; schedule secured by rhythm, not sprints
Fix a minimum output unit: a daily quota of pages as the non-negotiable floor — good days and bad shift only the margin, never the floor
Allow incremental patching: notes amended as new research arrives, without breaking the rhythm — pipeline decoupled from revision
One milestone: the finished draft — thirty years without a launch event; external communication minimized, the rhythm unswayed by outside feedback
representative_cases_zh: 1259 年起笔至 1286 年前后定稿、约二十七年的连续作业：跨越战乱、亡国、迁徙三个扰动源而不中断——节律的韧性
亡国后不仕的空白被注书日课填满：政治退场恰与学术满勤同时发生——节律替代身份
注本的规模（今整理本逾千万字级别）与'手不停批'的日课记录互证：长期恒速胜过短期爆发
representative_cases_en: From first pen around 1259 to finalization near 1286, some twenty-seven years of continuous work spanning war, dynastic collapse and displacement without interruption — the resilience of rhythm
After the fall, the blank left by office filled by daily annotation: political exit coinciding with full scholarly attendance — rhythm substituting for identity
The scale of the notes (millions of characters in modern editions) corroborated by the record of the unpausing hand: long-term constant speed beats short bursts
modern_applications_zh: 开源项目的'每天一个 commit'纪律：大型文档翻译与重构靠恒速推进
学术写作的页数日课与'不办发布会'：专著以节律完成，而非等灵感或等评审
个人养老金式的学习投资：每日最小投入、三十年复利——节律的金融版
modern_applications_en: The 'one commit a day' discipline in open source: vast translations and refactors advanced at constant speed
Page-a-day quotas and 'no launch events' in scholarly writing: monographs finished by rhythm, not by inspiration or review cycles
Pension-style learning investment: minimal daily input compounding over thirty years — rhythm in its financial form
representative_figures: 胡三省（核心）
司马光（上游：《通鉴》本身十九年成书的节律——被注者的日课典范）
安东尼·特罗洛普（跨文明平行：每早三页、写出四十七部小说——写作日课的现代原型）
竺可桢（平行：数十年不断气象日记——观测式节律的科学版）

modes.definition_en: Thirty years of 'the unpausing hand': annotating a vast work rests on steady daily output, not flashes of inspiration — convert a lifetime's workload into pages per day; the rhythm itself is the schedule

modes.name_en: The Method of Entrusting to Future Knowers
modes.domain_zh: 把作品的估值权委托给后人而非当代：'吾成此书……后世必有知者'——不营销、不索取承认，只保证作品可被未来的知者读懂，承认问题转化为可读性问题
modes.domain_en: Entrust a work's valuation to posterity, not the present: 'I finished this book... there will be knowers in later generations' — no promotion, no claim on recognition; only ensure the work can be read by future knowers — recognition recast as a readability problem
modes.source_chapter: 胡三省临终语及《音注》递藏刊行
modes.key_quote_zh: 吾成此书，初不谋于人而人莫之知，后世必有知者
modes.key_quote_en: 'I finished this book without seeking anyone's notice, and none knew it — there will be knowers in later generations.'
process_zh: 放弃当代承认的争夺：宋遗民身份使'当世之名'不可得也不可求——承认函数的时间参数被外生重置
把精力全部投向可读性：注释本身就最大化的'为陌生读者铺设入口'——为未来知者降低阅读门槛是唯一可控变量
建设传递链而非营销链：稿本递藏（袁桷）、刊行（元末）靠学术价值自发接力——好作品自建分发
临终明示信念而非遗嘱安排：'后世必有知者'是说给作品听的——信心成为作品的一部分
process_en: Forfeit the contest for contemporary recognition: as a Song loyalist, present fame was neither available nor pursuable — the time parameter of the recognition function reset exogenously
Invest everything in readability: annotation is itself maximal 'paving entrances for unknown readers' — lowering future knowers' reading threshold is the only controllable variable
Build a transmission chain, not a marketing chain: the manuscript's passage through Yuan Jue and late-Yuan printing relayed by scholarly value alone — good works build their own distribution
Declare the belief, not a bequest: 'there will be knowers' is spoken to the work — confidence becomes part of the work
representative_cases_zh: 《音注》生前无刻本、身后经袁桷递藏至元末刊行：三百年间从'人莫之知'到'《通鉴》功臣'——延时承认的完整案例
清代考据学全面采纳胡注：地名、职官、纪年考释成为标准工具——'知者'以整个学派的形式到来
临终语被写入传世文献：信念本身成为作品传播的一部分——胡三省的'自注'最终由后世完成
representative_cases_en: No printed edition in his lifetime; transmission through Yuan Jue to a late-Yuan printing: three centuries from 'none knew it' to 'great patron of the Tongjian' — delayed recognition in full
The Qing evidential school adopting Hu's notes wholesale: place-name, office and calendar explanations becoming standard tools — the knowers arrived as an entire school
The deathbed words entering the biographical literature: the belief itself became part of the work's transmission — Hu's final self-annotation completed by posterity
modern_applications_zh: 开源作者的'作品自证'策略：不追热度，把 README 与文档做到陌生人可独立上手——承认交给搜索与口碑
基础研究的延时兑现：数学定理数十年后被应用（如数论之于密码学）——'后世知者'的制度化形态
个人知识库的'为陌生人写作'：笔记假设一个毫无背景的读者——可读性是留给未来的接口
modern_applications_en: The 'work speaks for itself' strategy of open-source authors: no trend-chasing; make the README and docs self-sufficient for strangers — recognition left to search and word of mouth
Delayed payoff in basic research: theorems applied decades later (number theory to cryptography) — 'future knowers' institutionalized
Writing one's knowledge base for a stranger: notes assuming a reader with zero context — readability as the interface left to the future
